headline: Antonelli is fit and fast in Mexico, Intel has its worst day since 1974, and North Korea is blamed for a $6bn Binance hack.

upcoming.what: F1 Mexico City GP qualifying, 21:00 Irish time
UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs Nolan, Las Vegas. Main card from about 23:00–midnight Irish time
F1 Mexico City GP race, 20:00 Irish time. Antonelli can clinch the title
Final ISS spacewalk to finish the solar array upgrade
WEC season finale, 6 Hours of Monza
UFC 334, New York: Gane vs Hokit for the heavyweight title (main card early Sun 15 Nov Irish time)

items.headline: Intel and Reddit both lose about 29% as the Nasdaq slides
items.summary: Intel's weak Q4 outlook, blamed on a PC slump and a factory accident in Israel, gave it its worst day since 1974. Reddit beat on revenue but missed on users, and the Nasdaq fell 2.8%, with Alphabet also down sharply.

items.headline: North Korea blamed for the $6.3bn Binance hack
items.summary: TRM Labs links what may be the biggest crypto theft ever to North Korea's TraderTraitor group. Binance has promised to cover all user losses.

items.headline: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI to hit 200+ organisations in 11 days
items.summary: The campaign reportedly ran on an AI tool built around a DeepSeek model, an early example of AI speeding up state-backed intrusion work.

items.headline: Formal verification is the new hot bet for AI-written code
items.summary: A wave of startups wants to prove software is correct mathematically rather than just test it. One of them, &Truth, raised a $70m seed round.

items.headline: Vulcan return to flight set for Friday 13 November
items.summary: ULA has picked a date for Vulcan's comeback after its grounding, a little firmer than the 'mid-November' it gave earlier.

items.headline: Artemis III core stage joins its boosters at Kennedy
items.summary: The SLS core stage for the next crewed Moon mission has been stacked between its solid rocket boosters in the Vehicle Assembly Building.

items.headline: Sky tonight: Mars moves toward Leo
items.summary: Mars is heading toward Leo in the pre-dawn sky. Look east before sunrise if it's clear.

items.headline: FFXIV's Evercold expansion slips to 23 February 2027
items.summary: Square Enix moved the expansion back from January. Early access starts the same day, and pre-orders open on 4 November.

items.headline: John Romero's shooter, dropped by Xbox, finds a new publisher
items.summary: Romero says the game is saved, though he hasn't named the backer. The studio rehired 10 developers and cut the project down for a smaller team.

items.headline: Watchlist: quiet day
items.summary: There was nothing new on The Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, The Witcher 3 or Borderlands 4 in the last 24 hours.

items.headline: No-Gi Euros: black-belt finals this weekend
items.summary: The adult black-belt divisions and absolutes run in Rome on Saturday and Sunday. Results weren't out at press time, so check back tomorrow.

items.headline: Moicano vs Nolan headlines Halloween night in Vegas
items.summary: Moicano (Renato Carneiro) meets Australian prospect Tom Nolan at lightweight. Also on the main card: Erosa vs Jeong Yeong Lee and Marshall vs Bolaños. Weigh-in results weren't confirmed at press time, and no Irish or UK fighters are listed.

items.headline: Antonelli shakes off illness to run near the top in practice
items.summary: After missing media day sick, the title leader was second in FP1 and fourth in FP2, about two tenths off the pace. Leclerc topped both sessions.

items.headline: Norris and Russell stay close behind Leclerc in FP2
items.summary: Norris and Russell were both within about a tenth of the Ferrari, with Verstappen and Hadjar next. Antonelli needs roughly a top-nine finish on Sunday to wrap up the title.
